stories.title: Attackers Are Turning Everyday Business Emails Into Malware Delivery Machines
stories.description: Attackers use fake delivery and refund complaints to trick employees into downloading ZIP files containing PureRAT and PureLogs malware.

stories.title: Microsoft Confirms Windows 11 Update Bug Causing Black Screens and Loading Issues
stories.description: Microsoft has confirmed a Windows 11 issue that can leave users staring at a black screen after signing in, with the desktop shell failing to start automatically.

stories.title: Google Ads Campaign Spreads Fake Security Alerts That Lock Browsers and Push Malware
stories.description: Malicious ads redirect users to fake security warnings that mimic browser takeovers and push victims to call fraudulent support lines.

stories.title: Windows, Linux, Android File Notification Systems Leak User Activity
stories.description: Researchers show that file-change notification systems can leak keystroke timing, browsing activity, and WhatsApp media events.

stories.title: Bitget Says Suspected North Korean Hackers Stole $351.6M After Backend Compromise
stories.description: Bitget says suspected North Korean actors stole $351.6 million after compromising a backend wallet system and spoofing transaction data.

stories.title: CISA Warns of Multiple Check Point Product Vulnerabilities Exploited in Attacks
stories.description: CISA added two Check Point vulnerabilities to its KEV Catalog, warning that attackers are actively exploiting the flaws in affected environments.

stories.title: Roundcube Pre-Auth SQL Injection Flaw Actively Exploited in the Wild
stories.description: Roundcube's patched CVE-2026-48842 SQL injection is actively exploited, affecting 1.6.x before 1.6.16 and 1.7.x before 1.7.1.

stories.title: ‘SalesBleed’ Flaws in Salesforce Agentforce Enabled Zero-Click Data Exfiltration
stories.description: Three vulnerabilities in Salesforce Agentforce allowed hackers to hijack trusted agents, steal data, and launch phishing attacks.

stories.title: Roundcube Webmail Vulnerability in Attackers’ Crosshairs
stories.description: Tracked as CVE-2026-48842, the exploited bug is an SQL injection that can be exploited without authentication.
